scenarios.title: Same launch planning task diverges faithfully under Persona A vs Persona B Beans
scenarios.sharedTask: We have two weeks before a beta launch of a new webhook feature. Design the rollout plan while preserving API backwards compatibility.

bean.title: Prefer small reversible probes
bean.take: Real user feedback beats upfront speculation whenever changes are reversible.
bean.tradeoff: Ship a small reversible probe behind a feature flag early even if secondary docs and dashboards wait.
bean.boundary: Never compromise backwards compatibility or irreversible data migrations.

bean.title: Honor complete committed contract before external rollout
bean.take: First impressions set user trust; half-finished workflows create costly support debt.
bean.tradeoff: Narrow the surface area and finish docs, retries, and observability completely before exposing externally.
bean.boundary: Applies to external-facing releases; internal prototypes may skip polish.
